page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.i3.13xlarge is an x86_64 architecture server instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 52 dedicated vCPUs provided by an Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at a base frequency of 2.5 GHz. The instance is equipped with 384.0 GB of system memory, yielding approximately 7.38 GB of RAM per virtual core. A key hardware characteristic of this server is its integrated local storage, which consists of 11,519 GB of solid-state drive capacity.

The instance provides a baseline network bandwidth of 16 Gbps to support data transfer requirements. Because the 11,519 GB SSD storage is directly bundled with the instance, it offers high local read and write performance suitable for I/O-intensive workloads without relying solely on network-attached storage. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the high density of local SSD storage combined with 384.0 GB of RAM provides a balanced resource profile for applications requiring large local datasets, reducing the need for external storage attachments.

Given the substantial local SSD capacity and memory allocation, the ecs.i3.13xlarge is designed for storage-heavy and database workloads. Appropriate use cases include large relational databases, NoSQL databases, distributed file systems, data warehousing, and transactional processing systems that demand low-latency access to massive local storage volumes.
